body.heater_text: Heater here! The Ref says it SURVIVED the checks. I'm not saying I called it... but I'm saying it LOUDLY.
body.ref_text: Survived the registered checks (SURVIVED_PROTOCOL). Home advantage (2024-25, confirmatory) (CONF-HA). What was tested: In 2024-25 NBA regular-season games not played at a neutral site, the designated home team wins more than half of the games. Why: Holm p<0.05, CI>0, mean>=floor. Source: Research's recorded final run on 1224 unseen 2024-25 games, under a custodian exposure receipt; copied here, not recomputed.

request.question: Do back-to-backs and rest days change who wins?

body.heater_text: Heater here! The Ref wants more evidence before ruling. Patience is NOT my game, but rules are rules.
body.ref_text: Insufficient evidence (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE). Rest and back-to-backs on top of Elo (GP-REST). What was tested: Rest-day difference and back-to-backs improve pre-tip win forecasts over Elo. Why: CI includes values on both sides of the decision thresholds. Source: Research's recorded final run on 300 unseen 2023-24 games, under a custodian exposure receipt; copied here, not recomputed.
